source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-22: Doom of Cassomir

notes.saves: +2 to fortitude saves vs. attempts to grapple or shove

items.name: Hard to Grapple or Shove
items.text: Little Zura gains a +2 to fortitude saves against attempts to grapple or shove.

items.name: Belly Grease
items.text: The slurk extrudes a slippery grease from its ventral glands to coat the floor under it and in a 5-foot emanation, turning the affected area into uneven ground for 10 minutes, after which it dries to a putrid crust. The DC to balance dc=20 across the slime is 20.

items.name: Entangling Slime
items.text:
A creature struck by a slurk's slime squirt becomes Clumsy 1 and takes a –5-foot penalty to Speed for 1 hour or until the slime is removed. The slime can be removed with a total of three Interact actions by the entangled creature or creatures adjacent to the creature.

These actions don't need to be consecutive or made by the same creature.

Effect: Entangling Slime
